args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label made the Mid-Atlantic receiving supervisor search twice, and the label change was added to the handoff list.
- "PHL" is also the shorthand for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, a separate account. The two get mixed up in retail notes and in port-logistics search results.
- Moss's Coastal cheat sheet still lists the retail account as "Covey & Lark Retail (Covey / CLR / PHL)" with no mention of the rename. It does say to verify the org ID before running bulk seat audits, because of the PHL collision.
- To tell the rows apart: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Open question: we haven't confirmed whether the saved report was relabelled after 18 May.

Thanks,
Bettina (drafted with Sofia Marchetti's notes)
